content:
kevin: FYI spotted a 404 in the runtime guide under kv-cache -> prefetch image. hitting the CDN gives 404.
kevin: curl output:
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/images/kv-prefetch.png
HTTP/2 404
```
maria: thanks for catching this. sounds like the image got removed during a migration. i can rehost under /static/images and update the markdown.
sam: who's the owner for that page? want to assign a reviewer. @docs-bot can you show page metadata?
docs-bot: Page metadata: owners: team-runtime; path: content/runtime/kv-cache.md; last_edit: 2025-11-02
lee: typical fix: add image to repo static dir, update link to /static/images/..., and add a small redirect from the old CDN url via netlify/_redirects or our CDN config if possible. example sed patch below:
```
git checkout -b docs/fix/kv-prefetch-image
# in content/runtime/kv-cache.md replace CDN url with /static/images/kv-prefetch.png
sed -i "s|https://cdn.redwood.ai/images/kv-prefetch.png|/static/images/kv-prefetch.png|g" content/runtime/kv-cache.md
```
carla: please also add alt text and a short caption, our markdown linter yells otherwise. e.g. `alt="KV prefetch flow"` and caption `Figure: KV prefetch sequence`.
maria: i'm on it. will upload image to content/static/images/kv-prefetch.png and open a PR with the edit.
maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120 (branch: docs/fix/kv-prefetch-image)
sam: i'll take review tomorrow morning. also +1 to adding a small redirect rule so legacy links still work.
kevin: also adding a linkcheck entry to CI to include /static on deploy jobs so we catch similar misses earlier. here's a one-liner to test locally:
```
./scripts/linkcheck --paths content/runtime/kv-cache.md --allow-local /static
```
carla: nice. after merge can someone run the linkcheck against staging preview to confirm the asset resolution?
maria: will run it and report back. merging after sam lgtm.
kevin: if you run into permission issues when committing the image ping infra-docs; sometimes the static bucket requires a small ACL tweak.
lee: noted. small follow-up: can we add a docs health chore to sweep for CDN 404s monthly? i can sketch a GH Action to curl common cdn hostnames and report.
sam: sounds good, file it as a tiny infra task in the docs backlog.
maria: merged PR after sam review; staging preview shows image present and linkcheck passed. closing the loop. :tada:
kevin: awesome, thanks everyone.
